title: Sirock — już w progu
description: 36 klatek / 1,5 s. Sirock już w otwartych drzwiach po przebitce na reakcję. Mokra blond postać z opuszczonymi rękami, skrzydło otwarte na zewnątrz. Nie pokazujemy samego otwierania. Osobny Start, bez End.

prompts.image: Reuse exact approved open-door End v002 as standalone Start; no image generation.
prompts.animation: 0.0–1.1s: Already standing in the open doorway, Sirock shifts her weight slightly forward onto her leading boot and settles, looking into the room toward screen left. 1.1–3.0s: Hold the same composed stance with both arms lowered. Camera: locked-off. Secondary motion: drops fall from her wet blonde hair while rain continues outside. Preserve her exact identity, ordinary eyes, black clothing and the existing open-door geometry. The door stays stationary. Avoid repeating the opening, touching a handle, extra steps, indoor rainfall, dry hair, new people, anatomical distortion or cuts.
